description: Digital Media Library (DML) - a releasable Apache Sling Feature Model (https://github.com/apache/sling-org-apache-sling-feature). It bundles, by Maven coordinates, the DML server bundle and the slim client bundle, the ui.apps / client-ui.apps / sample-content packages, the FFM rendition-service OSGi configuration and the RepoInit that registers the AEM (dam:/cq:) node types the DML content relies on. A downstream project running its own Sling Starter can consume this as a single artifact in its launcher aggregate, e.g. <includeArtifact> org.motorbrot:slingslop.launcher:slingosgifeature:digitalmedia:VERSION </includeArtifact>, while depending on org.motorbrot:digitalmedia.client.core (jar) in its own bundles/apps. The full DML app then lives only in the launcher; the consumer's code only needs the slim client bundle.
